verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents a hosted MCP server that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment and calendar tools to any compatible client, plus Skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Together with full-text thread search, labels for tracking conversation state, drafts for human review, and sending, an external agent can read, triage, draft and send end to end through a documented connection. missing for 10: no evidence of connecting a user's existing personal mailbox (e.g., Gmail/Outlook) rather than an AgentMail-hosted inbox, no ChatGPT-specific connection docs, no independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools to any compatible client
This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.
Use `Labels` to track the state of a conversation.
An agent can create a `Draft` for a sensitive or important `Message`, which a human can then review and approve before it's sent.
To start a new conversation, you can send a Message from one of your inboxes.
so a LangGraph agent can send, reply, draft, label, and search email through a real inbox without any glue code.
